input.title: refactor(llm): remove dead provider helpers
input.body:
## Summary

- remove the unused BaseLLM stop-word implementation helper
- remove unreachable synchronous and asynchronous Anthropic follow-up conversation helpers
- remove unused Bedrock Nova and media-format helpers
- remove the test that directly exercised the otherwise unreachable Anthropic private method

## Why

Repository-wide reference tracing found no production call sites for these private helpers. The Anthropic synchronous helper was only referenced by its unit test and was already mar

output.summary: This PR removes unused helper functions and tests related to Anthropic's tool use conversation flow, which is not part of the active runtime behavior.
output.risk_rationale: The removed code and tests do not affect public APIs or core functionality. The changes are confined to private helper methods and their associated test cases.
focus_areas: Code removal and refactoring in LLM providers
Test case cleanup for Anthropic provider
